Glossary
AIDS Acquired immunodeﬁciency syndrome – a severe disease of the human immune system caused by the human
immunodeﬁciency virus (HIV).
Antiretroviral drugs (ARVs) Drugs used to treat HIV.
Antiretroviral therapy (ART) Treatment with combinations of several drugs against HIV.
Body mass index (BMI) Calculated as weight in kg per height in meters squared; often used as an indicator of overall
nutritional status.
CD4 cells A subgroup of lymphocytes which are targets of HIV infection. Destruction of CD4 cells is both a cause and a marker
of HIV/AIDS disease progression; therefore blood CD4 count is often used to measure the degree of immunodeﬁciency.
